prompt: Make a U.S.-popular hybrid-casual puzzle game

positions.position: Circuit Bloom fits U.S. hybrid-casual expectations by pairing simple input with collection progress.
evidence: The first action must expose the core fun immediately.
Map the first-session funnel from first tap to first win.
Use visual cues and responsive feedback to keep goals readable.

positions.position: Moment-to-moment play needs stronger first-action feedback and a fast first success.
evidence: Default rubric prioritizes clarity, feedback, and first success.

positions.position: Three levels should introduce, vary, and test the mechanic without random-feeling failures.
evidence: Seed requires exactly 3 levels and fair challenge.

positions.position: Static HTML/CSS/JS output is the safest demo-stable path with no backend or external APIs.
evidence: Seed excludes backend, external APIs, auth, and database.
